jumper.en: A short wire that joins two terminals so current can pass straight through.

line.en: The live supply conductor. It carries the 230 V relative to earth.

neutral.en: The return conductor that completes the loop; bonded to earth by the supplier, but still part of the working circuit.

earth.en: Protective conductor tied to the metal chassis. Carries current only during a fault.

spade.en: Flat push-on terminal (female spade on the wire, male tab on the part).

ssr.en: Solid-state relay: an electronic switch where a small low-voltage signal turns a mains load on and off, with no moving contacts.
